text:
lauren: Heads-up — planning to run the phased DDL + backfill tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Primary steps: add nullable column to `users.profile`, lightweight index, start chunked backfill job `backfill/users_profile_default`, then swap to NOT NULL and drop legacy index. Will coordinate canary at 2 shards. :eyes:

mike: +1. Can you paste the exact migration plan and the holdpoints? Need to know when to pause traffic and when to escalate.

lauren: plan gist: 1) `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN profile_v2 JSONB NULL;` 2) create index concurrently `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_profile_v2 ON users USING gin (profile_v2);` 3) launch backfill job (10m chunks, concurrency 8) 4) verify metrics 5) set NOT NULL / swap callers 6) cleanup. Holdpoints: after index create, after first 10% canary backfill, before NOT NULL.

carmen: we should pin the service image to `web:v2.14.3` for the window, and call out the change in release notes. I've added a short blurb in the Release Notes doc — will paste in morning. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Migration ticket #MI-4821 scheduled by lauren for 2024-06-02T02:00Z. Canary rollout: shards [us-east-1a, eu-west-1b] at 02:10Z. Auto-rollback threshold: 3 consecutive backfill job failures or replication lag > 60s.

ashley: Rollback acceptance criteria proposal: immediate rollback if any of 
- backfill job failing > 5% of processed chunks in 15m
- pg_stat_replication delay > 45s sustained for > 5m
- application error rate on write paths increases > 1% above baseline.
We should list these in the runbook.

mike: Agree with criteria. Also suggest a manual holdpoint at 02:30Z after 25% progress so SRE can validate tail latency and p95 for writes. If p95 increases > 200ms, we abort.

lauren: noted. I'll add the holdpoint and the `--dry-run` verification steps: `./deploy_migration --ticket MI-4821 --dry-run` then `./deploy_migration --ticket MI-4821 --start`.

sre-oncall: Oncall will throttle background backfill via the orch if we see CPU contention. Plan is to cap backfill concurrency to 4 if host CPU > 75% for 3m. We'll be watching replica lag and 95th latency (Apm -> env=prod, route=/api/*).

carmen: Please also include feature-flag gating: rollout behind `ff.users.profile_v2`. We can enable for 10% while backfilling, then ramp to 100% after NOT NULL swap.

lauren: added. Also prepping a small SQL safety check we’ll run before NOT NULL: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE profile_v2 IS NULL;
``` If > 0 we DO NOT set NOT NULL and escalate to runbook.

ashley: Good. One more: include steps for release-note rollback messaging (who pings customer success / infra slack). I'll draft the message.

mike: During the canary we'll watch metrics: `write latency p95`, `error rate`, `replica lag`, and `locks wait queue`. If deadlocks spike, we abort and revert via backup restore / feature-flag fallback.

lauren: final checklist uploaded to the ticket: preflight test, dry-run, two approvals (eng-release + SRE), deploybot manual start, pause at holdpoints, monitoring, finalize. I'll ping this thread again 30m before window.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30 minutes before migration window. React with :rocket: when ready.

mike: Reacting :rocket: — will be online for the window.

carmen: Added release-note snippet and pinned doc in the ticket. Will notify CS if we hit rollback.

lauren: thanks all — see you in the window.
